lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. Each column contains between three and five distinct local maxima arranged in a regular vertical sequence.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a rectilinear grid of high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, high-luminance circular pixel clusters that are significantly reduced in diameter compared to the primary lateral flank blobs.
